reference_change.title: perf: use native WebStream API instead of Readable.fromWeb wrapper

workload.source: written here from examples/benchmark/webstream.js, the benchmark https://github.com/fastify/fastify/pull/6444 adds (a handler returning a web Response whose body is a ReadableStream): served in process by app.inject, a fixed warm-up then a fixed window, eval/tasks/workloads/fastify-fastify-pr6444/bench.js

oracle.source: fastify's web-stream and stream tests, with test/web-api.test.js, which https://github.com/fastify/fastify/pull/6444 adds (so it is required on the reference tree only); targeted tests only

evidence.note: description, as matched by the miner: speedup claims: 20% improvement | timings: 36.6 ms; 30.4 ms | benchmark files changed: examples/benchmark/webstream.js

status_reason: built here and ran workload and oracle on the task and reference trees; see runs. Dependencies installed with npm install --ignore-scripts and --before the merge date (the repository has no lockfile). Node is v24 from nvm. The warm-up and window counts were not chosen from a warm-up curve; the workload's direction of effect was seen once per tree The workload was edited after this run (its reported value is printed with toPrecision(12) instead of toFixed(9)), and it has not been run again, so the workload is marked unverified and the status is builds: the workload was run only in an earlier form.
